description: This file contains functions for handling image attachments in an Android chat application, including loading, decoding, resizing, and encoding images, as well as caching bitmaps.

classes.name: LruCache<String, Bitmap>
classes.description: A cache for storing decoded bitmaps with a maximum size of 16MB, customized to measure size by bytes of Bitmap.

classes.name: PendingImageAttachment
classes.description: Data class (not shown in the snippet) representing an image attachment with its metadata.

methods.name: loadSizedImageAttachment
methods.description: Loads an image from a Uri, scales it to an optimal size for chat attachments, and encodes it as a base64 string.

methods.name: decodeBase64Bitmap
methods.description: Decodes a Base64-encoded string into a Bitmap, utilizing caching and downsampling for efficiency.

methods.name: computeInSampleSize
methods.description: Calculates the appropriate inSampleSize for BitmapFactory to efficiently decode large images.

methods.name: normalizeAttachmentFileName
methods.description: Sanitizes and normalizes a raw filename string, ensuring it ends with .jpg.
